metadata.coverage_note: 189 entries were translated locally; 7 glossary entries were preserved, and the 346-entry candidate covers current stable messages and inventoried Avida-ED controls. Codex-assisted wording suggestions remain pending competent review. A full visible-string inventory and qualified Spanish scientific-language review remain open.
metadata.review_gate: Before review/promotion, compare the complete runtime source inventory, calculate each unit hash over source text/context/placeholder contract, validate placeholder parity and plural variants, and obtain competent Spanish scientific-language review.
metadata.plural_and_number_handling: Draft message variants use explicit one/other forms. Runtime selection and locale number formatting must use the browser Intl.PluralRules and Intl.NumberFormat bridge; do not enable this file until that path and placeholder parity are tested.
metadata.rendering_rule: All values are plain text. Insert with a text API, never innerHTML.
metadata.translation_method: Bounded batch translation with TalkOrigins glossary, exact-ID preservation, and placeholder checks.
metadata.terminology_lineage: Relevant general terms follow the TalkOrigins Spanish translation compendium; Avida-specific distinctions are explicit overrides.

messages.source: How does the mutation setting affect genetic variation over time?
messages.value: ¿Cómo afecta la configuración de mutación a la variación genética a lo largo del tiempo?

messages.source: Sequence richness is the number of distinct genome sequences present.
messages.value: La riqueza de secuencias es el número de secuencias genómicas distintas presentes.

messages.source: Compare runs as observations; one run does not establish a general outcome.
messages.value: Compare las ejecuciones como observaciones; una sola ejecución no establece un resultado general.

messages.source: Run the same 10 × 10 world with three fixed seeds. Compare observations; a single run is not a general result.
messages.value: Ejecute el mismo mundo de 10 × 10 con tres semillas fijas. Compare las observaciones; una sola ejecución no es un resultado general.

messages.source: The bundled ancestor, CPU and instruction set, grid, and nine Avida-ED 4-aligned logic-task reward strengths stay fixed. The POC applies them through metabolic multipliers. This is selection-active evolution, not neutral evolution.
messages.value: El ancestro incluido, el conjunto de instrucciones, la cuadrícula y las nueve intensidades de recompensa de tareas lógicas, alineadas con Avida-ED 4, permanecen fijos. El prototipo las aplica mediante multiplicadores metabólicos. Esta es evolución activa por selección, no evolución neutral.

messages.source: Sequence richness counts distinct ordered sequences present now. It is not a mutation count or every sequence ever seen. More sequences do not establish greater fitness or adaptation. Treat each run as an observation, not a universal outcome.
messages.value: La riqueza de secuencias cuenta las secuencias ordenadas distintas presentes ahora. No es un conteo de mutaciones ni todas las secuencias jamás vistas. Más secuencias no establecen mayor aptitud o adaptación. Trate cada ejecución como una observación, no como un resultado universal.
